long_description: Valera Health is a virtual behavioral healthcare practice specializing in high-acuity mental health care for patients ages 6 and above with serious mental illness and severe depression. The company uses a team-based care model with health coaches, therapists, and physicians working together to deliver longitudinal care. Valera emphasizes measurable quality through patient-reported outcome measures collected at various intervals, supported by a unified electronic medical record and digital platform. In 2024, Valera raised $9.1M toward an $18.2M funding round, and in June 2025 acquired Vita Health, a digital suicide prevention startup, to expand clinical capacity for acute patients. Valera has received NCQA accreditation for Credentialing and Recredentialing and is positioning for value-based care contracting that rewards clinical quality over volume. The company partners with major health plans including Humana, CDPHP, and Harvard Pilgrim Health Care.

faqs.q: What type of patients does Valera Health treat?
faqs.a: Valera Health specializes in high-acuity mental health care for patients ages 6+ with serious mental illness (SMI) and severe depression, using a team-based care model.

faqs.q: What is Valera Health's care model?
faqs.a: Valera uses team-based care with health coaches, therapists, and physicians working together. Patients are matched to a dedicated care team, with ongoing longitudinal care supported by a unified EMR.

faqs.q: Does Valera Health use measurement-based care?
faqs.a: Yes, Valera collects patient-reported outcome measures at various intervals using their unified digital platform, emphasizing both process and outcome measures.
